claim: Python 3.14's forkserver needs a main guard and dead-register subprocesses an explicit fork context, and a virtual environment must be called by absolute path or a relative run path can make JNext miss the card copy.

evidence.text: Python 3.14 forkserver needs a main guard; dead-register subprocesses use an explicit fork context.
A venv must be called by absolute path or Python warns about sys.prefix; a relative run path made JNext miss the card copy (byte_exact False showed it).
